description:
Reads one authorized gift or the original own send receipt.
Use when: explicit private item gift actions after reading horizon://docs/item-gifts. Claim offers and returns with horizon_claim_inbox.
Not for: automatic gifting, polling or generated replacement operations. Use horizon_get_item_gift_operation to reconcile the original intent.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: Read only. Missing receipts never authorize replacement IDs; retained receipts never withdraw or charge again.
Returns: {receipt,serverTime}; the receipt is the fee proof
Errors: 409 REVISION_CONFLICT, OPERATION_CONFLICT, OPERATION_EXPIRED, STATE_CONFLICT and GIFT_EXPIRED, GIFT_DECLINED, GIFT_ALREADY_CLAIMED, GIFT_UNAVAILABLE need explicit reconciliation, never fresh revisions or operation IDs on an unknown outcome. Missing OPERATION_NOT_FOUND does not prove nonexecution. RECIPIENT_INBOX_FULL and 422 SELF_GIFT, ITEM_EQUIPPED, OPEN_GIFT_LIMIT_REACHED, GIFT_LIMIT_REACHED, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE withdraw and charge nothing. 403 ITEM_GIFTS_DISABLED. 404 RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND hides blocks. 429 ITEM_GIFTS_RATE_LIMITED schedules no retry. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

sessionToken.description: Current accessToken sent only as Bearer

userId.description: Active player matching the current session and project

name: horizon_get_item_gift_operation
title: Get Original Item Gift Receipt
